text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: It's all over now, isn't it~

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
That was so fun!
We made so many memories, it felt just like summer vacation!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Like when we tried to make fireworks together and got scolded by Air Groove-san!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Like burying a time capsule,
only for nobody to take note of where it was!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Or when we did a test of courage, something chased us,
and we all hid in a mountain cabin trembling till morning!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
It was a packed summer.
I had so much fun.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: ...Madam Chairwoman said some nice things to me, too.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I haven't really set any clear goals yet
for what I want to do or where I want to go from here, though.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
But for now, I want to do my very best in the Kikuka Sho!
Mun!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's right! Actually, I put together
a tentative training plan!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"There's also some strength training I want to get started on right away today!
I'll tell you all about it at our meeting once we get back!"

Heading toward the Kikuka Sho,
she seems plenty fired up in her own way!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Still, everyone's running late, aren't they?
I think it's almost time, though..."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ah, you're off by an hour on the bus schedule.

In any case, faintly sensing the next step forward,
this year's summer training camp came to a close.
